name: Asato
source:
A one-track minded warrior from the closed-off village of Kira. Having grown up being shunned by the other villagers, he is unaccustomed to interacting with others, and so he has a hard time dealing with crowds and a simplistic, almost child-like manner of speech. Despite his social awkwardness, he is very loyal and fiercely protective of those he likes.

[Based on [url=http://lamento.wikia.com/wiki/Asato]Lamento Wiki[/url] & [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lamento_-BEYOND_THE_VOID-]Wikipedia[/url]]
